notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for an ordinary federation restore that is started and then aborted. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time selection when needed. It verifies a completed save prerequisite, restore request success, restore-begun and initiate-federate-restore callbacks, Abort Federation Restore, RESTORE_ABORTED terminal callbacks, terminal restore status, and standard federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador federation save, restore, abort, status, resignation, destruction, and disconnect services with FederateAmbassador save/restore lifecycle callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador save/restore declarations and FederateAmbassador restore callback declarations
